arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kevin Russell argued the Act applies to debt collectors. He stated the definition includes those collecting debts owed or due to another.
Santander's counsel argued the sole question is whether debt buyers qualify. He stated they collect for their own account.
Justice Alito questioned why debt buyers are excluded if they acquired debt after default.
Chief Justice Roberts noted the text gives different tenses to owed and due.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Fair Debt Collection Practices Act defines debt collectors. It includes those who collect debts owed or due to another. Henson claims Santander fits this definition. Santander claims it does not.
